relevance_note: One kindred with three sisters compound heterozygous for LCAT T123I and an intron 4 mutation: "Three sisters were shown to suffer from fish-eye disease (FED)", with per-subject data for 14 tested relatives.
method_note: Read the paper by hand; a Python script assembled the JSON and copied table-row spans directly from the Table I and Table II lines (checked against the tables). Scope: the three compound heterozygous sisters (III-2, III-5, III-6, called 'probands'), eight heterozygous relatives (T123I: III-1, III-3, IV-1, IV-2, IV-3; intron: III-9, III-10, III-11) and six relatives whose DNA status is 'Normal' (III-4, III-7, III-8, III-12, III-13, III-14), all labelled by the paper's pedigree labels. The paper never says which of III-2/III-5/III-6 is the 52-year-old female index patient (the pedigree arrow is in Figure 1, an image), so the index patient's individual facts (age 52, abdominal pain, constipation, endoscopy without abnormalities, treated for irritable bowel disease, congenital corneal cloudiness, leukocyte RT-PCR) are not assigned to any row; no separate row was created for her to avoid double-counting. Variant numbering 'C 2182 to T' and 'T 2327 to C' is gene-sequence numbering (McLean 1986 genomic sequence), recorded as genomic coordinates; no c./p. HGVS is printed; 'T123I' (mature protein numbering) recorded as the protein string. Inheritance left 'not reported': the paper says 'the T123I defect originated from the father's side of the family' and the intron mutation carriers were in 'the other branch of the pedigree', but does not state that a named parent carries either variant. Intron variant type left 'not reported' (described as intronic/branchpoint point mutation causing intron retention, no class word from the enum). 'None of the three sisters nor their family members were known to suffer from premature atherosclerosis' was not recorded as an exclusion (hedged 'not known', and narrower than the checklist item). Heterozygotes' 'low normal HDL-cholesterol and apo A-I' and 'low normal CERs' were not recorded (borderline normal wording). III-1 has 'nd' for all LCAT parameters and III-6 'nd' for LCAT concentration, so group statements about those parameters were not applied to them. Table I header gives 'mmol/liter' for apo A-1 and apo B columns too (apparently a conversion artefact); values are quoted without asserting the unit. Contradiction: the Results text says 'we identified four T123I carriers within the same family', but Table I and Table II list five T123I heterozygotes (III-1, III-3, IV-1, IV-2, IV-3). Subject III-10 was not fasted (Table I note).

span: we could not detect LCAT activity nor LCAT mass in the culture medium harvested from the LCAT-Int4-MUT cell line
sequence analysis of the 392 bp product revealed the presence of unspliced intron 4 including the T-C base substitution
the larger DNA fragment contained intron 4 with the intron mutation and exclusively encoded for Thr at position 123
the intron mutation results in fully abnormal LCAT mRNA processing in vivo
